**Round 444: PASS.** `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. No bugs found.

All 11 of C's rows (C1–C11) passed, as did the C5 HEAD control. The full vitest suite, typecheck, build, Biome and verify were not run by C. They are gate rows.

- **Scope:** the changed paths match the 8 granted ones at the start and the end of my checks. The 6 sketch files are byte-identical to B's copies.
- **Unit tests:** the covering set passed, 25 files and 440 tests. All 8 mutants failed on the same test rows as B's results.
- **Browser, IME search (C5):** 18 of 18 cells OK at 1440×900 and 1280×720. The 1440 Library-search Escape cell timed out on cold start, so I re-ran it and it passed.
- **Browser, HEAD control:** 14 of 18 cells fail on HEAD, the same cells as B's baseline. The 1440 cell I re-ran there also failed.
- **Neighbours:** the stage-1 site and held-key probes are both 18 of 18 OK.
- **Focus targets (C7):** all six cells match HEAD, and the focus ring is visible in each. A fresh Escape in the Library search clears it and keeps focus there. ArrowDown lands on the first result. Escape in the shortcut sheet closes it and returns focus to the "Keyboard shortcuts (?)" button.
- **Premium auth (C8):** an anonymous `/studio-lab` has `auth_user` null. Play reaches Playing and Stop returns to Stopped at both viewports. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required", 0 `audio[src]`, and the studio token request returns 401. Auth is not bypassed. This was a state and UI check. I did not measure the audio graph or an export file this round.
- **Docs and claims:** doc 288 and doc 289 status lines are exact, the template headings are in order, and the named tests exist. The claims script output has no diff against B's.

Not verified, and not counted as a fail: real OS IME, AltGr and Android behaviour. The native search clear under a real IME is also unconfirmed. The AltGraph half has no browser row, because Playwright can't set it, so only the jsdom test and mutant M3 cover it. These stay on the Tech Lead manual check (deadline RETRO 450). Ableton conformance does not apply to this round.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/` (`c-round-444.md`, `c-round-444.json`, and `c-round-444/` for evidence). `c-round-444.json` passes `tools/l57-check.py`.
